title: Change-point Synthesizer for Usage/Cost/Latency with Auto-Responder
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Customers and platform owners need more actionable, low-noise detection of sustained shifts (change points) in usage, cost, and P99 latency that indicate regressions or configuration issues. Existing spike-based rules generate noisy alerts for transient bursts and miss gradual drift.

Scope: Build a console backend service component and pipeline stage that synthesizes change-point detections across usage/cost/latency time series per-tenant and per-route, fuses multi-signal evidence, computes a graded confidence score, and triggers an automated responder workflow when thresholds are exceeded. The solution should integrate with existing telemetry ingestion (Kafka->ClickHouse/Parquet), use windowed seasonality-aware baselines, support tenant-aware priors, and feed structured findings into the alerting bus and Console incident workflows.

Goals:
- Detect abrupt and gradual change points with low false-positive rate for tenant-level SLO regressions.
- Provide explainability: contributing signals, time window, magnitude, and suggested mitigation.
- Support suppression and deduplication across correlated signals and tenants.
- Optionally trigger automated mitigations (e.g., autoscale snapshot, route to compatible model variant, increase capacity reservation) for P0 alerts with human-in-the-loop confirmation.

Non-goals: Full ML-based root-cause classification in scope 1; this will be added in follow-ups after we validate signal quality.
acceptance_criteria: Service computes change-point events for usage/cost/latency streams and writes findings to the alert-bus with schema: tenant_id, route, metric, timestamp, change_type, magnitude, confidence
End-to-end pipeline demo: synthetic regression injected into staging traffic produces a high-confidence change-point and an alert in Console within SLA (<5 minutes)
False positive rate on historical replay (last 90 days) measured and below 4% for medium/high-confidence alerts on top 100 tenants
Console shows explanatory fields for each alert (contributing metrics, recent window plots, suggested next steps)
Playbook runner can execute a safe automated mitigation with two-step approval for P0s and record actions in audit logs
implementation_notes: Pipeline stage will run in Flink/Beam cluster consuming aggregated telemetry topic; compute streaming change-point scores using a hybrid approach: seasonal decomposition + robust online change point detector (CUSUM + Bayesian online CPD heuristics)
Maintain tenant adaptive thresholds by tracking long-run baseline and volatility; use EWMA for drift smoothing and percentile windows for seasonality
Fuse signals (usage, cost, p50, p95, p99) using logistic score model with calibrated thresholds to yield confidence buckets (low/medium/high)
Store raw candidate events in ClickHouse table 'changepoint_candidates_v1' for auditing and offline evaluation
Add deduplication layer keyed by tenant+route+time_bucket to collapse simultaneous alerts across metrics
Expose feature flags to enable/disable auto-response per-tenant and per-release channel
Instrumentation: add telemetry counters for candidate rate, alert emission rate, false_positive_estimates, and pipeline lag

2026-03-06 - Security (Elena Ruiz): Confirm audit log schema records actor for automated mitigations; add KMS-backed signing for playbook actions

testing_plan: Unit tests for detector logic with synthetic signals (abrupt jumps, gradual drift, seasonal cycles)
Backfill replay against 90 days of production telemetry to compute precision/recall and rate estimates
Canary deployment: enable detection for 1% of tenants and monitor false positive rate and alert volume for 72h
Load test: ensure pipeline keeps up with peak aggregated message rate with <30s processing lag
rollback_plan: Feature flag to disable change-point emission; runbook to revert Flink job to previous topology and delete in-flight candidate index in ClickHouse. Communicate rollback on #platform-ops and notify customers on any P0 actions taken.
mitigations: Temporary suppression window per tenant when maintenance is scheduled
Auto-scale snapshot: trigger a capacity bump on Dedicated pools with human confirmation
Route traffic to compatible model variant when latency regression detected and variant available
Create low-noise 'info' alerts for medium-confidence events, escalate to paging only for high-confidence
